tei:div.tei:p: rol mo bsgrag: spos bsreg: tshe mda' g.yab dbyangs snyan pos 'di skad do: hūm̐ hrī: rang bzhin ka dag rnam rol pho brang nas: rang byung gshis lugs bla ma kun tu bzang: gsal dag 'og min pad brtsegs gzhal yas nas: rnam grol bla ma snang mtha' tshe dpag med: steng phyogs skye med lhun grub pho brang nas: ye grol bla ma 'phags mchog nam mkha'i rgyal: lnga ldan dwangs ma thig le'i gzhal yas nas: skye 'chi gnyis spangs mtsho skyes rdo rje rtsal: kun bzang yab yum 'khril sbyor gzi byin 'bar: sngon gyi thugs dam gnyan po dbyings dgongs la: 'dir byon bsgrub rdzas rnams la byin chen phob: tshe 'bras 'di la snod bcud tshe bkrag stims: tshe mda' 'di la legs nyes pra rtags ston: 'chi med tshe bcud dngos grub char bzhin phob: 'dod dgu'i longs spyod dpal 'bar g.yang khug cig: hūm̐ hrī: lho nub rak+sha srin yul dpal ri nas: 'chi med pad+ma las 'khrungs sprul pa'i sku: bde sbyor lha mo ḍā ki tsaṇ+ḍa lī: chos dbyings gdal khyab yangs pa rgyal ba'i zhing: phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho dang: 'og min mkha' spyod 'ja' thig gzhal yas nas: dus gsum tshe bdag rig 'dzin rgya mtsho rnams: bla ma rig 'dzin gzi byin g.yang khug cig: hūm̐ hrī: chos dbyings 'gyur med rdo rje'i gzhal yas nas: dus gsum rgyal ba longs spyod rdzogs sku'i tshogs: phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i gzi byin g.yang khug cig: hūm̐ hrī: bde chen mā ra ti ka'i gzhal yas nas: rgyal kun dbang phyug rig 'dzin sam+bha wa: mchog gsang bde rol ḍā ki man+dhā ra: bod yul gangs can g.ya' lung gzhal yas nas: o rgyan pad+ma tshe yi dbang phyug rtsal: bde stong gnyis med sbyor ba'i mtsho rgyal yum: sngon gyi thugs dam gnyan po dbyings dgongs la: 'dir byon bsgrub rdzas rnams la byin chen phob: tshe 'bras 'di la snod bcud bkrag mdangs stims:

tshe mda' 'di la legs nyes pra rtags ston: 'chi med tshe bcud dngos grub char bzhin phob: 'dod dgu'i longs spyod dpal g.yang tshe khug cig: hūm̐ hrī: bde chen rang bzhin rnam dag dbyings nyid nas: theg dgu rgyud sde bzhi drug yi dam lha: bde chen dbang drag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: h+ya grī wa lag na rdo rje'i tshogs: rang bzhin lhun grub mkha' spyod 'ja' gur nas: rgyal kun yum mchog rdo rje rnal 'byor ma: rang rang gnas yul dur khrod pho brang nas: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong zhing skyong dang: bka' srung pho nya rang rang bka' 'khor tshogs: 'dod dgu rnam bzhi 'grub pa'i tshe g.yang khug: stong gsum mi mjed 'jig rten rnam dag nas: bstan bdag dus gsum ston pa rgya mtsho dang: bstan 'dzin 'gro ba'i dpal mgon skyes bu rnams: rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas pa'i tshe g.yang khug: spar sme lo grangs 'byung ba'i dbang sgyur dang: srid pa'i lha rabs gzhi bdag dge bsnyen dang: phyi nang gsang ba'i lha srung gnyan po rnams: rang rang las dbang drags pos tshe g.yang khug: phyogs skyong bcu sogs 'jigs byed chen po dgu: lha klu zo dor rgyu skar nyi shu brgyad: gtsang ma ris kyi dpal mgon bdun cu rnams: stobs rtsal gzi brjid bskyed pa'i tshe g.yang khug: lo zla zhag grangs dus tshod dbang sgyur ba'i: rtse lha zhing dang sgo thab lha g.yang can: rten 'brel legs dgu sgrub pa'i lha tshogs rnams: 'bru nor longs spyod dpal g.yang tshe khug cig: e ma: mtsho skyes sku gsum tshe yi lha tshogs rnams: 'chi med sgrub pa'i gnas mchog nyams re dga': rig 'dzin sgrub pa po rnams brjid re che: lhun grub dkyil 'khor 'di ni byin re chags: tshil chen dud sprin sna tshogs 'khrigs se 'khrigs: zhun chen snang gsal mar me ya la la: tshe 'bras nyi zla'i rgyan can spungs se spung: phyi ltar tshe 'bras rdo rje lu gu rgyud:

nang ltar mtsho skyes sku gsum tshe yi lha: gsang ba 'pho gzhom mi mnga' dam pa'i rdzas: tshe mda' 'jigs med rdo rje tshe yi lha: tshe rten bla g.yu dmar po 'od du 'bar: snang srid kun gsal dngul dkar me long brgyan: le brgan dmar po'i cod pan pu ru ru: 'dir byon mtsho skyes rdo rje tshe yi lha: 'jigs med tshe yi lha tshogs dam tshig can: phyi nang snod bcud 'byung ba'i tshe bkrag kun: 'dir khug tshe rten rnams la bcud du phob: sha khrag srog dbugs lus kyi tshe nyams na: snang srid 'byung ba'i bcud mchog ma lus kun: 'dir khug nyams pa gsos la tshe g.yang spel: gzhom gzhig mi mnga' tshe yi dngos grub stsol: nad med bde ba'i dbang mchog bskur du gsol: ces so// maṅga laṃ/// /
